mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.variant_id, s.sku_code, s.size, s.price, s.sale_price, s.stock, s.status, p.name AS product_name, v.name AS variant_name FROM skus s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN product_variants v ON v.id=s.variant_id WHERE s.id=#{id} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND s.status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE skus SET stock=stock-#{quantity} WHERE id=#{skuId} AND stock >= #{quantity} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders deleted_at IS NULL AND status=#{status}AND (order_code ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR customer_name ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR customer_phone ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT *FROM orders WHERE id=#{id}AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT *FROM order_items WHERE order_id=#{orderId}ORDER BY created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE orders SET payment_method=#{paymentMethod}, payment_status=#{paymentStatus}, paid_at=#{paidAt} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE orders SET shipping_method=#{shippingMethod}, shipping_status=#{shippingStatus}, tracking_code=#{trackingCode} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,order_id,old_status,new_status,note,created_by,created_at FROM order_status_history WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
